reason: A DeepSeek Harness channel integration that bridges DSH sessions with Feishu bots for bidirectional chat, streaming cards, model controls, image handling, and file or image delivery.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话连接到飞书机器人，支持双向消息、流式卡片、模型控制以及图片和文件传输。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness sessions to Feishu bots with bidirectional messaging, streaming cards, model controls, and image or file transfer.

capabilities: Receives messages from Feishu chats over a WebSocket connection
Sends text, cards, images, files, and reactions to Feishu chats
Bridges Feishu messages to DSH agent sessions and returns agent responses
Persists Feishu-to-session bindings and session-related metadata locally
Uses Feishu app credentials and exposes local Feishu management endpoints
